name: problem_071_kv_cache_update_with_rope_cuda_cpp
author: sol-baselines-handport
description: Fused KV cache update with RoPE applied to new key states. One CTA per (batch, kv_head, output_seq_position); head_dim threads per block. The first current_seq_len output positions copy from the existing cache; the last new_seq_len output positions apply RoPE via the given cos/sin to new keys and copy new values raw. RoPE is staged in fp32 to match the reference pytorch bf16 multiply-add round-trip.
